sections.sectionDescription: Systematic breakdown of the AI solution components

subsections.subsectionDescription: Maps to FAIRA Table 1: AI solution (Questions 1.1-1.10)

fields.questionText: What is the primary function of the AI solution?
What version of the AI solution does this FAIRA assessment apply to?
Select all AI features that apply:
What decisions will be addressed by the AI functionality?
What tangible benefits does this AI solution provide?
Can the AI solution convert decisions into actions without human intervention?
What type of AI model or technique is used?

conditionalFields.placeholder: Please specify other AI model types

fields.questionText: What is the source of the AI solution?
How does the AI solution integrate with other systems?

subsections.subsectionDescription: Maps to FAIRA 1.8-1.9 (data used and data quality) and AI use inputs (Table 3)

fields.questionText: How are AI use inputs tracked and recorded?
options: No inputs tracked or recorded (flag as risk)

fields.questionText: Does the AI require data from the digital or physical environment? If yes, what data and can users limit or trace it?
fields.placeholder: Describe environmental data requirements and user controls

fields.questionText: What safeguards exist to detect and handle corrupted, missing, or out-of-range data inputs?
What data does the AI solution use?
Rate the quality of the input data
What is the Business Impact Level (BIL) of the input data?
Does the solution use regulated data?
Does the solution require user inputs to operate?

subsections.subsectionDescription: Maps to FAIRA Table 2 (HMI) and Table 5 (Object of AI action)

fields.questionText: How does the system interface with humans?
What expertise is required to use the AI solution?
Who will be impacted by the AI system?
How will impacted parties be informed of AI use?
What are the expected impacts of this AI solution on staff?
Rate the overall severity of these impacts
How will each impacted group be affected?
Rate the overall severity of these impacts

subsections.subsectionDescription: Maps to FAIRA Table 4: AI use outputs

fields.questionText: What are the primary outputs of the AI system?
Are outputs sent to external systems without human review?
What is the Business Impact Level (BIL) of the outputs?
How are AI outputs tracked and recorded?
Could any AI outputs allow unauthorised access to information?
Do outputs involve data regulated by law?
Do outputs contain personally identifiable information? Who can access it (internal / external)?
fields.placeholder: Describe PII in outputs and access controls

fields.questionText: Are any AI outputs directly used to trigger actions with legal or regulatory effect? If yes, describe and justify.

subsections.subsectionDescription: Maps to FAIRA Table 9 (Monitoring & evaluation) plus accountability references

fields.questionText: Who is accountable for decisions made using this system?
How are AI use inputs and outputs tracked and recorded?
What monitoring and evaluation processes are in place?
How frequently will monitoring and evaluation occur?
Has the AI solution been subject to independent review?
Who is responsible for monitoring and evaluation?
How are stakeholders engaged in monitoring and evaluation?
How are undesirable or harmful results detected?
Which values and principles informed the AI solution's design?
Which sector-specific frameworks and obligations apply?
Where will this AI solution be deployed?
Which national and international AI frameworks and standards apply?
options: National Framework for the Assurance of AI in Government

stateStructure.description: Flat state structure with all fields at root level

componentTypes.radio: Radio button group for single selection
componentTypes.radio_scale: Radio buttons arranged as numerical scale (1-5 or 1-3)

conditionalLogic.description: Fields that appear/hide based on parent field values

features.autoSave: Form auto-saves every 3 seconds after user stops typing/selecting
features.manualSave: User can manually save draft via 'Save Draft' button
features.progressTracking: Real-time progress percentage displayed in header
features.progressBar: Visual progress bar at top of page
features.responsiveLayout: 2-column grid for options on medium+ screens
